### Headline summary
- Microsoft released a record 1,413 security fixes in its October 2026 Patch Tuesday update. ([CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4234759/october-patch-tuesday-roundup-over-1400-microsoft-holes-to-be-plugged-including-three-zero-days.html), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/microsoft-patches-record-1413-flaws.html))
- CISA warned of active exploitation of a zero-day in Ivanti Connect Secure and a Windows Shell vulnerability. ([Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/10/14/ivanti-zero-days-gain-root-patched-vpn-appliances/), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/200895/hacking/volexity-uncovers-stealthy-ivanti-vpn-attack-using-three-zero-day-vulnerabilities.html), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/windows-shell-0-day-exploited/), [News4Hackers](https://www.news4hackers.com/microsoft-addresses-critical-mark-of-the-web-bypass-vulnerability-cve-2026-96951/))
- US authorities disrupted North Korean laptop farms and seized over one billion malicious phishing messages. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/us-arrests-two-in-crackdown-on-north-korean-it-worker-laptop-farms/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/famous-chollima/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/microsoft-disrupts-chinese-language-phishing-market-behind-1b-messages/), [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/global-takedown-hits-network-behind-1-billion-phishing-messages/))

### Microsoft October 2026 Patch Tuesday
Microsoft released its October 2026 security updates, which included a record number of fixes addressing 1,413 flaws. ([CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4234759/october-patch-tuesday-roundup-over-1400-microsoft-holes-to-be-plugged-including-three-zero-days.html), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/microsoft-patches-record-1413-flaws.html), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/microsoft-patches-record-1413-vulnerabilities-including-exploited-windows-zero-day/), [HackRead](https://hackread.com/microsoft-fix-vulnerabilities-october-patch-tuesday-update/))

### Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Day Exploitation
CISA warned administrators to immediately fix a zero-day vulnerability in Ivanti Connect Secure that is being actively exploited, including through multi-vulnerability exploit chains. ([Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/10/14/ivanti-zero-days-gain-root-patched-vpn-appliances/), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/200895/hacking/volexity-uncovers-stealthy-ivanti-vpn-attack-using-three-zero-day-vulnerabilities.html), [HIPAA Journal](https://www.hipaajournal.com/ivanti-connect-secure-zero-day-2026/), [CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4235129/hackers-abuse-the-ivanti-connect-secure-bug-to-gain-access-without-accounts.html))

### Windows Shell Zero-Day Actively Exploited
Microsoft patched CVE-2026-96951, a high-severity Windows Shell vulnerability that bypasses Mark of the Web and is being actively exploited in attacks. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/windows-shell-0-day-exploited/), [News4Hackers](https://www.news4hackers.com/microsoft-addresses-critical-mark-of-the-web-bypass-vulnerability-cve-2026-96951/), [SOC Prime Blog](https://socprime.com/blog/cve-2026-96951-analysis/))

### Cisco Secure Email Gateway zero-day exploitation
Cisco patched a critical zero-day vulnerability in its Secure Email Gateway that is being actively exploited by attackers to bypass authentication. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisco-patches-actively-exploited-secure-email-gateway-zero-day/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/cisco-warns-of-active-attacks.html))

### FBI Disrupts North Korean Laptop Farms
US authorities raided over 40 locations in Texas, seizing 187 laptops and charging 14 individuals linked to the North Korean threat group Famous Chollima. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/us-arrests-two-in-crackdown-on-north-korean-it-worker-laptop-farms/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/famous-chollima/), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/10/14/north-korean-it-workers-laptop-farms-arrests/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/us-shuts-down-over-40-laptop-farms.html))

### Microsoft Disrupts Chinese Phishing Infrastructure
Microsoft and partners seized domains and disrupted major Chinese-language phishing kits, including YAM Store, that facilitated over one billion malicious messages. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/microsoft-disrupts-chinese-language-phishing-market-behind-1b-messages/), [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/global-takedown-hits-network-behind-1-billion-phishing-messages/), [The Record](https://therecord.media/microsoft-takes-down-3-major-chinese-phishing-platforms), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/microsoft-disrupts-3-phishing-kits.html))

### Browser Security Updates
Google Chrome and Mozilla Firefox released updates patching numerous security flaws, with Chrome addressing 37 vulnerabilities and the combined updates covering 114 flaws. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/chrome-firefox-updates-patch-114-flaws-as-mozilla-unveils-firefox-enterprise/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/multiple-google-chrome-vulnerabilities/), [/r/cybersecurity](https://www.reddit.com/r/cybersecurity/comments/1x5q397/multiple_flaws_chrome_155_update_patches_37/), [CIS](https://www.cisecurity.org/advisory/multiple-vulnerabilities-in-google-chrome-could-allow-for-arbitrary-code-execution_2026-116))

### SAP patches critical NetWeaver and S/4HANA flaws
SAP released 22 security updates, including four critical vulnerabilities in NetWeaver and S/4HANA that could allow attackers to execute code and compromise systems. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/sap-patches-critical-netweaver-s-4hana-vulnerabilities/), [News4Hackers](https://www.news4hackers.com/sap-releases-critical-security-patches-for-netweaver-and-s-4hana/))
